    | exact fun h => hqr (hpq h)

theorem checked_refinement_transitive (p q r : drivepolicy.Policies) (knob : policycompare.Knob)
    (hpq : policycompare.at_least_as_strict_on p q knob = ok true)
    (hqr : policycompare.at_least_as_strict_on q r knob = ok true)
    (b : Bool) (hpr : policycompare.at_least_as_strict_on p r knob = ok b) : b = true := by
  exact (refinement_ok p r knob b hpr).2
    (refinement_trans knob ((refinement_ok p q knob true hpq).1 rfl)
      ((refinement_ok q r knob true hqr).1 rfl))

theorem append_weaker_ok (out : alloc.vec.Vec policycompare.Knob) (p d : drivepolicy.Policies)
    (kind : model.DriveKind) (knob : policycompare.Knob) (r : alloc.vec.Vec policycompare.Knob)
    (h : policycompare.append_weaker out p d kind knob = ok r) :
    r.val = out.val ++ (if PolicyWeak p d kind knob then [knob] else []) := by
  classical
  cases knob <;> unfold policycompare.append_weaker at h <;> h5i_invert h
  all_goals try have ha := applies_ok _ _ _ hdefaultable
  all_goals try have hr := refinement_ok _ _ _ _ hb1
  all_goals try have hp := push_ok h
  all_goals simp_all [PolicyWeak, PolicyDefaultable, PolicyApplies]


theorem filter_cons_selected {α : Type} (P : α → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (x : α) (xs : List α) :
    (x :: xs).filter (fun a => decide (P a)) = (if P x then [x] else []) ++ xs.filter (fun a => decide (P a)) := by
  by_cases h : P x <;> simp [h]

theorem weaker_ok (p d : drivepolicy.Policies) (kind : model.DriveKind)
    (r : alloc.vec.Vec policycompare.Knob) (h : policycompare.weaker_than p d kind = ok r) :
    r.val = PolicyWeakerList p d kind := by
  classical
  unfold policycompare.weaker_than at h
  h5i_invert h
  have hp0 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hout
  have hp1 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hout1
  have hp2 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hout2
  have hp3 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hout3
  have hp4 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hout4
  have hp5 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hout5
  have hp6 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hout6
  have hp7 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hout7
  have hp8 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hout8
  have hp9 := append_weaker_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ h
  simp only [PolicyWeakerList, PolicyKnobOrder, filter_cons_selected, List.filter_nil]
  simp_all [alloc.vec.Vec.new, List.append_assoc]

theorem parsed_ok (raw : Slice U8) (knob : policycompare.Knob)
    (h : policycompare.knob_from_bytes raw = ok knob) : PolicyKnobParsed raw.val knob := by
  unfold policycompare.knob_from_bytes at h
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals simp only [lift, Result.ok.injEq] at *
  all_goals subst_vars
  all_goals have he := oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudBytes.equal_ok _ _ _ hb
  all_goals try have he1 := oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudBytes.equal_ok _ _ _ hb1
  all_goals try have he2 := oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudBytes.equal_ok _ _ _ hb2
  all_goals try have he3 := oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudBytes.equal_ok _ _ _ hb3
  all_goals try have he4 := oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudBytes.equal_ok _ _ _ hb4
  all_goals try have he5 := oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudBytes.equal_ok _ _ _ hb5
  all_goals try have he6 := oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudBytes.equal_ok _ _ _ hb6
  all_goals try have he7 := oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudBytes.equal_ok _ _ _ hb7
  all_goals try have he8 := oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudBytes.equal_ok _ _ _ hb8
  all_goals try have he9 := oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudBytes.equal_ok _ _ _ hb9
  all_goals simp_all [PolicyKnobParsed, PolicyKnobWire, PolicyKnobNames, Array.to_slice, Array.make]

theorem applies_bytes_ok (raw : Slice U8) (kind : model.DriveKind) (r : Bool)
    (h : policycompare.knob_applies_to_kind_bytes raw kind = ok r) :
    ∃ k, PolicyKnobParsed raw.val k ∧ (r = true ↔ PolicyApplies k kind) := by
  unfold policycompare.knob_applies_to_kind_bytes at h
  h5i_invert h
  exact ⟨k, parsed_ok raw k hk, applies_ok k kind r h⟩

theorem strictness_bytes_ok (raw : Slice U8)  (r : policycompare.Strictness)
    (h : policycompare.knob_strictness_bytes raw = ok r) :
    ∃ k, PolicyKnobParsed raw.val k ∧ PolicyStrictness k r := by
  unfold policycompare.knob_strictness_bytes at h
  h5i_invert h
  exact ⟨k, parsed_ok raw k hk, strictness_ok k r h⟩

theorem value_bytes_ok (raw : Slice U8) (p : drivepolicy.Policies) (r : policycompare.KnobValue)
    (h : policycompare.knob_value_bytes p raw = ok r) :
    ∃ k, PolicyKnobParsed raw.val k ∧ PolicyValue p k r := by
  unfold policycompare.knob_value_bytes at h
  h5i_invert h
  exact ⟨k, parsed_ok raw k hk, value_ok p k r h⟩

theorem bool_bytes_ok (raw : Slice U8) (p : drivepolicy.Policies) (r : Bool)
    (h : policycompare.knob_bool_bytes p raw = ok r) :
    ∃ k, PolicyKnobParsed raw.val k ∧ r = PolicyBit p k := by
  unfold policycompare.knob_bool_bytes at h
  h5i_invert h
  exact ⟨k, parsed_ok raw k hk, bool_ok p k r h⟩

theorem refinement_bytes_ok (raw : Slice U8) (p q : drivepolicy.Policies) (r : Bool)
    (h : policycompare.at_least_as_strict_on_bytes p q raw = ok r) :
    ∃ k, PolicyKnobParsed raw.val k ∧ (r = true ↔ PolicyRefines p q k) := by
  unfold policycompare.at_least_as_strict_on_bytes at h
  h5i_invert h
  exact ⟨k, parsed_ok raw k hk, refinement_ok p q k r h⟩

import Verified.Derived
import Spec

open H5iAppLib hiding lit


namespace oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudRefusedWritesNothing

macro "inv " h:ident : tactic => `(tactic| (
  repeat' (first
    | (simp only [H5iAppLib.bind_tc_eq_ok, H5iAppLib.bind_eq_ok, ok.injEq,
        core.result.Result.Ok.injEq, core.result.Result.Err.injEq,
        Prod.mk.injEq, reduceCtorEq, false_and, and_false, exists_false,
        exists_and_left, exists_and_right, exists_eq_left, exists_eq_right,
        Aeneas.Std.uncurry] at $h:ident)
    | (obtain ⟨(⟨_, _⟩ : _ × _), _, $h:ident⟩ := $h)
    | (obtain ⟨_, _, $h:ident⟩ := $h)
    | (split at $h:ident))))

theorem member_refused (db db' : model.Db) (env : grantapi.Env) (caller drive : U64)
    (s : model.Subject) (role : model.Role) (e : Option I64) (err : model.ErrorKind)
    (h : grantapi.set_member_role db env caller drive s role e = ok (db', .Err err)) :
    db' = db := by
  unfold grantapi.set_member_role at h
  obtain ⟨r, hr, h⟩ := bind_eq_ok.1 h
  obtain ⟨gates, hg, h⟩ := bind_eq_ok.1 h
  cases gates <;> inv h <;> simp_all

theorem refused_create_or_set_writes_nothing (db db' : model.Db) (env : grantapi.Env) (caller : U64)
    (r : model.Resource) (s : model.Subject) (role : model.Role) (e : Option I64) (req : grantapi.Request)
    (err : model.ErrorKind) (hq : req = .CreateGrant r s role e ∨ req = .SetRole r s role e)
    (h : grantapi.transition db env caller req = ok (db', .Err err)) :
    db' = db := by
  rcases hq with rfl | rfl
  · unfold grantapi.transition grantapi.create_grant at h
    inv h
    all_goals first | (simp_all; done) | exact member_refused _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h
  · unfold grantapi.transition grantapi.set_role_handler at h
    inv h
    all_goals first | (simp_all; done) | exact member_refused _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h

end oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudRefusedWritesNothing

import Verified.OxicloudBytes
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result oxicloud_kernel oxicloud_kernel.SpecKernel
open H5iAppLib hiding lit

namespace oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudSession

theorem origin_bytes_ok (o : session.SessionOrigin) (out : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : session.origin_bytes o = ok out) : out.val = OriginWire o := by
  cases o <;> unfold session.origin_bytes at h <;> h5i_invert h
  all_goals simp only [lift, Result.ok.injEq] at hs
  all_goals subst s
  all_goals have hc := copy_ok _ _ h
  all_goals simpa [OriginWire, Array.to_slice, Array.make] using hc

theorem origin_parse_ok (raw : Slice U8) (o : session.SessionOrigin)
    (h : session.origin_from_wire raw = ok o) : OriginDecoded raw.val o := by
  unfold session.origin_from_wire at h
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals simp only [lift, Result.ok.injEq] at *
  all_goals subst_vars
  all_goals have he := equal_ok _ _ _ hb
  all_goals try have he1 := equal_ok _ _ _ hb1
  all_goals try have he2 := equal_ok _ _ _ hb2
  all_goals try have he3 := equal_ok _ _ _ hb3
  all_goals try have he4 := equal_ok _ _ _ hb4
  all_goals intro known hk
  all_goals cases known <;> simp_all [OriginWire, Array.to_slice, Array.make]

/-- Lossless restoration preserves the complete security snapshot through its public views. -/
theorem restored_readback (snapshot r : session.Session)
    (h : session.from_raw snapshot.id snapshot.user_id snapshot.refresh_token snapshot.expires_at snapshot.ip_address snapshot.user_agent snapshot.created_at snapshot.revoked snapshot.family_id snapshot.oidc_id_token snapshot.oidc_sid snapshot.dpop_jkt snapshot.origin snapshot.last_seen_at = ok r) :
    session.id r = ok snapshot.id ∧
    session.user_id r = ok snapshot.user_id ∧
    session.refresh_token r = ok snapshot.refresh_token ∧
    session.expires_at r = ok snapshot.expires_at ∧
    session.ip_address r = ok snapshot.ip_address ∧
    session.user_agent r = ok snapshot.user_agent ∧
    session.created_at r = ok snapshot.created_at ∧
    session.is_revoked r = ok snapshot.revoked ∧
    session.family_id r = ok snapshot.family_id ∧
    session.oidc_id_token r = ok snapshot.oidc_id_token ∧
    session.oidc_sid r = ok snapshot.oidc_sid ∧
    session.dpop_jkt r = ok snapshot.dpop_jkt ∧
    session.origin r = ok snapshot.origin ∧
    session.last_seen_at r = ok snapshot.last_seen_at := by
  simp only [session.from_raw, Result.ok.injEq] at h
  subst r
  simp [session.id, session.user_id, session.refresh_token, session.expires_at, session.ip_address, session.user_agent, session.created_at, session.is_revoked, session.family_id, session.oidc_id_token, session.oidc_sid, session.dpop_jkt, session.origin, session.last_seen_at]

/-- Revocation is idempotent, and preserves every credential and authorization namespace. -/
theorem revoke_ok (s r : session.Session) (h : session.revoke s = ok r) :
    SessionRevoked s r ∧ session.revoke r = ok r := by
  simp only [session.revoke, Result.ok.injEq] at h
  subst r
  simp [SessionRevoked, session.revoke]

theorem bind_ok (s r : session.Session) (key : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : session.with_dpop_jkt s key = ok r) : SessionBound s key r := by
  cases hk : s.dpop_jkt <;> simp_all [session.with_dpop_jkt]
  subst r
  simp [SessionBound, hk]
  cases s
  simp_all

/-- A bound session cannot be rebound, including when the original key is empty. -/
theorem no_rebind (s : session.Session) (key : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (h : s.dpop_jkt ≠ none) :
    session.with_dpop_jkt s key = fail .panic := by
  cases hk : s.dpop_jkt <;> simp_all [session.with_dpop_jkt]

theorem token_attach_ok (s r : session.Session) (token : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : session.with_oidc_id_token s token = ok r) : SessionTokenAttached s token r := by
  simp only [session.with_oidc_id_token, Result.ok.injEq] at h
  subst r
  simp [SessionTokenAttached]

theorem sid_attach_ok (s r : session.Session) (sid : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : session.with_oidc_sid s sid = ok r) : SessionSidAttached s sid r := by
  simp only [session.with_oidc_sid, Result.ok.injEq] at h
  subst r
  simp [SessionSidAttached]

end oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudSession

Verified.OxicloudShareNeedsOwner.code:
import Verified.Derived
import Spec
import H5iAppLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result oxicloud_kernel oxicloud_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit

namespace oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudShareNeedsOwner

theorem live_ok (g : model.Grant) (now : I64) (h : acl.live g now = ok true) : Live g now := by
  unfold acl.live at h
  unfold Live Spec.live
  cases he : g.expires_at with
  | none => simp
  | some t => simp_all

theorem implies_share (r : model.Role) (h : acl.role_implies r .Share = ok true) : r = .Owner := by
  cases r <;> simp_all [acl.role_implies, model.Role.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqRole.eq, model.Role.read_discriminant]

theorem grants_share (r : model.Role) (h : acl.role_grants r .Share = ok true) : r = .Owner := by
  cases r <;> simp_all [acl.role_grants, model.Permission.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqPermission.eq, model.Permission.read_discriminant]

theorem direct_true (db : model.Db) types ids p r now
    (h : acl.direct_grant_exists db types ids p r now = ok true) :
    ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, acl.role_implies g.role p = ok true ∧ acl.live g now = ok true := by
  unfold acl.direct_grant_exists acl.direct_grant_exists_loop at h
  refine loop_idx_ok _ id db.grants.length (fun _ => True) (fun b => b = true → _) ?_ _ _ trivial (by simp) h rfl
  intro i res _ hle hb
  unfold acl.direct_grant_exists_loop.body at hb
  h5i_invert hb
  all_goals first
    | (intro _; exact ⟨g, vec_index_slice_ok_mem hg, by simp_all, by simp_all⟩)
    | (simp only [id]; h5i_ok_facts; refine ⟨trivial, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> scalar_tac)
    | simp

theorem cascade_true (db : model.Db) types ids p fid now
    (h : acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists db types ids p fid now = ok true) :
    ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, acl.role_implies g.role p = ok true ∧ acl.live g now = ok true := by
  unfold acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists at h
  h5i_invert h
  unfold acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists_loop at h
  refine loop_idx_ok _ id db.grants.length (fun _ => True) (fun b => b = true → _) ?_ _ _ trivial (by simp) h rfl
  intro i res _ hle hb
  unfold acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists_loop.body at hb
  h5i_invert hb
  all_goals first
    | (intro _; exact ⟨g, vec_index_slice_ok_mem hg, by simp_all, by simp_all⟩)
    | (simp only [id]; h5i_ok_facts; refine ⟨trivial, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> scalar_tac)
    | simp

theorem stronger_ok (best : Option model.Role) r o (h : acl.stronger best r = ok o) : o = some r ∨ o = best := by
  unfold acl.stronger at h
  h5i_invert h <;> simp

/-- Every role the drive scan has picked so far comes from a live grant. -/
def RoleOk (db : model.Db) (now : I64) (o : Option model.Role) : Prop :=
  ∀ ro, o = some ro → ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.role = ro ∧ acl.live g now = ok true

theorem caller_role_ok (db : model.Db) s d now o
    (h : acl.caller_role_on_drive db s d now = ok o) : RoleOk db now o := by
  unfold acl.caller_role_on_drive at h
  h5i_invert h
  unfold acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop at h
  refine loop_idx_ok _ (fun x => x.2) db.grants.length (fun x => RoleOk db now x.1) (RoleOk db now) ?_ _ _
    (by simp [RoleOk]) (by simp) h
  rintro ⟨best, i⟩ res hinv hle hb
  unfold acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop.body at hb
  h5i_invert hb
  · simp only
    h5i_ok_facts
    refine ⟨?_, by scalar_tac, by scalar_tac⟩
    simp only at hinv; show RoleOk db now best1
    split at hbest1
    · h5i_invert hbest1
      · rcases stronger_ok _ _ _ hbest1 with rfl | rfl
        · intro ro hro; cases hro; exact ⟨g, vec_index_slice_ok_mem hg, rfl, by simp_all⟩
        · exact hinv
      all_goals simp_all
    · simp_all
  · simpa using hinv

abbrev Goal (db : model.Db) (now : I64) : Prop := ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.role = .Owner ∧ Live g now

theorem of_grant (db : model.Db) now
    (h : ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, acl.role_implies g.role .Share = ok true ∧ acl.live g now = ok true) :
    Goal db now := by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, h1, h2⟩ := h
  exact ⟨g, hg, implies_share _ h1, live_ok _ _ h2⟩

theorem of_role_has (db : model.Db) now s d o (ho : acl.caller_role_on_drive db s d now = ok o)
    (h : acl.role_has o .Share = ok true) : Goal db now := by
  have hr := caller_role_ok _ _ _ _ _ ho
  unfold acl.role_has at h
  cases o with
  | none => simp at h
  | some ro =>
    obtain ⟨g, hg, rfl, hl⟩ := hr ro rfl
    exact ⟨g, hg, grants_share _ h, live_ok _ _ hl⟩

theorem of_cascade (db : model.Db) now s r (h : acl.cascade_grant db s r .Share now = ok true) :
    Goal db now := by
  unfold acl.cascade_grant at h
  h5i_invert h
  · obtain ⟨t, i⟩ := x_1
    exact of_grant _ _ (cascade_true _ _ _ _ _ _ h)
  · subst hc
    cases o with
    | none => simp at hfolder_allowed
    | some pf =>
      simp only at hfolder_allowed
      h5i_invert hfolder_allowed
      obtain ⟨t, i⟩ := x_1
      exact of_grant _ _ (cascade_true _ _ _ _ _ _ hfolder_allowed)
  · obtain ⟨t, i⟩ := x_1
    exact of_grant _ _ (direct_true _ _ _ _ _ _ h)

theorem share_needs_owner (db : model.Db) (ro : Bool) (now : I64) (s : model.Subject) (r : model.Resource)
    (h : acl.check db ro now s .Share r = ok true) :
    ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.role = .Owner ∧ Live g now := by
  unfold acl.check at h
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals first
    | exact of_cascade _ _ _ _ h
    | (obtain ⟨t, i⟩ := ‹alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec U64›
       exact of_grant _ _ (direct_true _ _ _ _ _ _ h))
    | (subst_vars
       exact of_role_has db now s _ _ ‹acl.caller_role_on_drive _ _ _ _ = ok _› ‹acl.role_has _ _ = ok true›)

end oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudShareNeedsOwner

def default_policies : model.DrivePolicies := ⟨false, false, false, false, false⟩

@[step] theorem drive_policies_spec (db : model.Db) (id : U64) :
    acl.drive_policies db id ⦃ result =>
      result = ((driveRow db id).map (·.policies)).getD default_policies ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.drive_policies acl.drive_policies_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search db.drives.val (fun d => decide (d.id = id))
    _root_.id (fun _ d => d.policies) default_policies _ ?_ 0#usize (by simp))
  · intro result hr
    simpa [driveRow, searchFrom_findD] using hr
  · intro i hi
    unfold acl.drive_policies_loop.body
    h5i_step [default_policies]

theorem drive_of_eq (db : model.Db) (r : model.Resource)
    (hs : isStorage r = true) : acl.drive_of db r = ok (driveOf db r) := by
  apply eq_ok_of_spec
  cases r <;> simp [isStorage] at hs
  all_goals
    unfold acl.drive_of driveOf
    step* <;> simp_all
  all_goals exact ⟨_, o_post.symm, rfl⟩

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

theorem policies_for_storage (db : model.Db) (r : model.Resource) (d : U64)
    (dr : model.Drive) (hs : isStorage r = true) (hd : driveOf db r = some d)
    (hr : driveRow db d = some dr) :
    grantapi.policies_for db r = ok (.Ok dr.policies) := by
  have hdo := drive_of_eq db r hs
  have hdp : acl.drive_policies db d = ok dr.policies := by
    simpa [hr] using eq_ok_of_spec (drive_policies_spec db d)
  cases r <;> simp [isStorage] at hs
  all_goals unfold grantapi.policies_for
  all_goals simp [hdo, hd, hdp]

theorem create_respects_sharing_policies (db db' : model.Db) (env : grantapi.Env) (caller : U64)
    (r : model.Resource) (s : model.Subject) (role : model.Role) (e : Option I64) (rep : grantapi.Reply)
    (d : U64) (dr : model.Drive) (hst : isStorage r = true) (hd : driveOf db r = some d)
    (hr : driveRow db d = some dr)
    (h : grantapi.transition db env caller (.CreateGrant r s role e) = ok (db', .Ok rep)) :
    dr.policies.forbid_sharing = false ∧ (∀ t, s = .Token t → dr.policies.forbid_public_links = false) := by
  unfold grantapi.transition grantapi.create_grant at h
  obtain ⟨decision, hdecision, h⟩ := bind_eq_ok.1 h
  cases decision with
  | Err err =>
    h5i_invert h
    all_goals simp_all
  | Ok unit =>
    obtain ⟨gate, hgate, h⟩ := bind_eq_ok.1 h
    cases gate with
    | Err err =>
      h5i_invert h
      all_goals simp_all
    | Ok unit =>
      unfold grantapi.create_gates at hgate
      rw [policies_for_storage db r d dr hst hd hr] at hgate
      cases r <;> simp [isStorage] at hst
      all_goals
        simp [grantapi.is_drive, core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch] at hgate
        h5i_invert hgate
        all_goals simp_all
      all_goals
        intro t hs
        subst s
        simp at htoken

end oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudSharingPolicies

import Verified.OxicloudBytes
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result oxicloud_kernel oxicloud_kernel.SpecKernel
open H5iAppLib hiding lit
namespace oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudSubjectGroup

theorem alphanumeric_ok (b : U8) (r : Bool) (h : subjectgroup.alphanumeric b = ok r) :
    (r = true ↔ GroupAlphanumeric b) := by
  unfold subjectgroup.alphanumeric at h
  h5i_invert h <;> simp_all [GroupAlphanumeric] <;> scalar_tac

theorem name_byte_ok (b : U8) (r : Bool) (h : subjectgroup.name_byte b = ok r) :
    (r = true ↔ GroupNameByte b) := by
  unfold subjectgroup.name_byte at h
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals have ha := alphanumeric_ok _ _ hb1
  all_goals simp_all [GroupNameByte] <;> scalar_tac

theorem all_name_ok (raw : Slice U8) (r : Bool)
    (h : subjectgroup.all_name raw = ok r) :
    (r = true ↔ ∀ b ∈ raw.val, GroupNameByte b) := by
  unfold subjectgroup.all_name subjectgroup.all_name_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _
    (fun i : Usize => ∀ j < i.val, ∀ b, raw.val[j]? = some b → GroupNameByte b)
    (fun r => r = true ↔ ∀ b ∈ raw.val, GroupNameByte b)
    (fun i => raw.val.length - i.val) ?_ 0#usize r (by simp) h
  intro i result hp hr
  unfold subjectgroup.all_name_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · obtain ⟨hi, he⟩ := slice_index_ok hi2
    have hb' := name_byte_ok _ _ hb
    have hj := add_ok_val hi3
    refine ⟨?_, by scalar_tac⟩
    intro j hji b heq
    by_cases hji' : j < i.val
    · exact hp j hji' b heq
    · have hj' : j = i.val := by scalar_tac
      subst j
      have heq' : raw.val[i.val]? = some i2 := by simp [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi, he]
      have : b = i2 := by simp_all
      subst b
      exact hb'.1 hc_1
  · obtain ⟨hi, he⟩ := slice_index_ok hi2
    have hb' := name_byte_ok _ _ hb
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff]
    intro hall
    have hm : i2 ∈ raw.val := by rw [← he]; exact List.getElem_mem hi
    have : GroupNameByte i2 := hall i2 hm
    simp_all
  · simp only [true_iff]
    intro b hb
    obtain ⟨j, hj, he⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.1 hb
    apply hp j (by scalar_tac) b
    simp [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hj, he]


theorem validation_ok (raw : Slice U8) (r : core.result.Result Unit subjectgroup.NameError)
    (h : subjectgroup.validate_name raw = ok r) : GroupNameDecision raw.val r := by
  unfold subjectgroup.validate_name at h
  h5i_invert h
  · simp only [GroupNameDecision]
    scalar_tac
  · simp only [GroupNameDecision]
    simp only [subjectgroup.MAX_NAME_LEN] at hc_1
    constructor <;> scalar_tac
  · obtain ⟨hi, he⟩ := slice_index_ok hi2
    have hs : GroupNameStart raw.val := by
      refine ⟨i2, ?_, (alphanumeric_ok _ _ hb).1 hc_2⟩
      exact List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mpr ⟨hi, he⟩
    have ha := (all_name_ok _ _ hb1).1 hc_3
    simp only [GroupNameDecision, ValidGroupName]
    simp only [subjectgroup.MAX_NAME_LEN] at hc_1
    exact ⟨by scalar_tac, by scalar_tac, hs, ha⟩
  · obtain ⟨hi, he⟩ := slice_index_ok hi2
    have hs : GroupNameStart raw.val := by
      refine ⟨i2, ?_, (alphanumeric_ok _ _ hb).1 hc_2⟩
      exact List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mpr ⟨hi, he⟩
    have ha : ¬ (∀ b ∈ raw.val, GroupNameByte b) := by
      intro hall
      exact hc_3 ((all_name_ok _ _ hb1).2 hall)
    simp only [GroupNameDecision]
    simp only [subjectgroup.MAX_NAME_LEN] at hc_1
    exact ⟨by scalar_tac, by scalar_tac, hs, ha⟩
  · obtain ⟨hi, he⟩ := slice_index_ok hi2
    have hn : ¬ GroupNameStart raw.val := by
      rintro ⟨c, hhead, ha⟩
      have heq : raw.val[0]? = some i2 := List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mpr ⟨hi, he⟩
      have : c = i2 := by simp_all
      subst c
      exact hc_2 ((alphanumeric_ok _ _ hb).2 ha)
    simp only [GroupNameDecision]
    simp only [subjectgroup.MAX_NAME_LEN] at hc_1
    exact ⟨by scalar_tac, by scalar_tac, hn⟩

theorem validation_exact (raw : Slice U8) (r : core.result.Result Unit subjectgroup.NameError)
    (h : subjectgroup.validate_name raw = ok r) :
    (r = .Ok () ↔ ValidGroupName raw.val) := by
  have hd := validation_ok raw r h
  cases r with
  | Ok unit => cases unit; simpa [GroupNameDecision] using hd
  | Err error =>
    cases error <;> simp_all [GroupNameDecision, ValidGroupName] <;> omega

theorem immutability_ok (group : subjectgroup.SubjectGroup) (r : Bool)
    (h : subjectgroup.is_immutable group = ok r) :
    (r = true ↔ group.is_virtual = true) := by
  simp only [subjectgroup.is_immutable, Result.ok.injEq] at h
  subst r
  rfl

end oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudSubjectGroup

import Verified.Derived
import Spec
import H5iAppLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result oxicloud_kernel oxicloud_kernel.Spec
open H5iAppLib hiding lit
namespace oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudTokenGrant

/-! ## Basic helpers and specifications -/

@[step] theorem contains_u8_spec (xs : Slice U8) (x : U8) :
    acl.contains_u8 xs x ⦃ b => b = true ↔ x ∈ xs.val ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.contains_u8 acl.contains_u8_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search xs.val (fun y => decide (y = x)) (fun b : Bool => b)
    (fun _ _ => true) false _ ?_ 0#usize (by simp))
  · intro r hr; rw [hr, searchFrom_const]; simp
  · intro j hj; unfold acl.contains_u8_loop.body; h5i_step

@[step] theorem contains_spec (ids : Slice U64) (x : U64) :
    acl.contains ids x ⦃ b => b = true ↔ x ∈ ids.val ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.contains acl.contains_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search ids.val (fun y => decide (y = x)) (fun b : Bool => b)
    (fun _ _ => true) false _ ?_ 0#usize (by simp))
  · intro r hr; rw [hr, searchFrom_const]; simp
  · intro j hj; unfold acl.contains_loop.body; h5i_step

theorem subject_matches_token (g : model.Grant) (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64) (t : U64)
    (htypes : types.val = [2#u8]) (hids : ids.val = [t]) :
    acl.subject_matches g types ids ⦃ b => b = true ↔ g.subject = .Token t ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.subject_matches acl.subject_type acl.subject_id
  cases g.subject <;> step* <;> simp_all

@[step] theorem subject_match_set_token_spec (db : model.Db) (t : U64) :
    acl.subject_match_set db (.Token t) ⦃ fun (types, ids) =>
      types.val = [2#u8] ∧ ids.val = [t] ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.subject_match_set
  step*

theorem live_equiv (g : model.Grant) (now : I64) :
    acl.live g now = ok true ↔ Live g now := by
  unfold acl.live Live live
  cases g.expires_at with
  | none => simp
  | some exp => simp only [ok.injEq]; rfl

theorem deref_val {α} (v : alloc.vec.Vec α) : (alloc.vec.Vec.deref v).val = v.val :=
  Slice.from_val v.val v.property

theorem token_grant_of_match (db : model.Db) (t : U64) (now : I64)
    (types : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (ids : alloc.vec.Vec U64)
    (hmatch : acl.subject_match_set db (.Token t) = ok (types, ids))
    (hex : ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, acl.subject_matches g (alloc.vec.Vec.deref types) (alloc.vec.Vec.deref ids) = ok true ∧ acl.live g now = ok true) :
    ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.subject = .Token t ∧ Live g now := by
  have hspec := subject_match_set_token_spec db t
  have hval := post_of_ok hspec hmatch
  obtain ⟨g, hg_in, hmatch_g, hlive_g⟩ := hex
  have hsubj := subject_matches_token g (alloc.vec.Vec.deref types) (alloc.vec.Vec.deref ids) t
    (by rw [deref_val, hval.1]) (by rw [deref_val, hval.2])
  have hsubj_val := (post_of_ok hsubj hmatch_g).1 rfl
  exact ⟨g, hg_in, hsubj_val, (live_equiv g now).1 hlive_g⟩

theorem add_one_val (i i2 : Usize) (hmax : i.val < Usize.max) (h : i + 1#usize = ok i2) :
    i2.val = i.val + 1 := by
  have hs : i + 1#usize ⦃ z => z.val = i.val + (1#usize : Usize).val ⦄ := by
    apply Usize.add_spec
    simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
    omega
  have hp := post_of_ok hs h
  simpa only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] using hp

/-! ## Loop 1: direct_grant_exists -/

theorem direct_step (db : model.Db) (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64)
    (p : model.Permission) (r_res : model.Resource) (now : I64)
    (i : Usize) (res : ControlFlow Usize Bool)
    (_ : i.val ≤ db.grants.val.length)
    (h : acl.direct_grant_exists_loop.body db types ids p r_res now i = ok res) :
    match res with
    | .done true => ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, acl.subject_matches g types ids = ok true ∧ acl.live g now = ok true
    | .done false => True
    | .cont i' => i'.val ≤ db.grants.val.length ∧ db.grants.val.length - i'.val < db.grants.val.length - i.val := by
  unfold acl.direct_grant_exists_loop.body at h
  dsimp only at h
  split at h
  · rename_i hlt
    have hlt_nat : i.val < db.grants.val.length := by
      have : (alloc.vec.Vec.len db.grants).val = db.grants.val.length := alloc.vec.Vec.len_val db.grants
      scalar_tac
    have himax : i.val < Usize.max := by
      have hp := db.grants.property
      omega
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
    have hg_in : g ∈ db.grants.val := by
      rw [alloc.vec.Vec.index_slice_index, alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize] at hg
      split at hg
      · simp at hg
      · rename_i hsome
        simp only [ok.injEq] at hg
        subst hg
        exact List.mem_of_getElem? hsome
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
    cases b
    · obtain ⟨i2, hi2, hres⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
      simp only [ok.injEq] at hres
      subst hres
      have := add_one_val i i2 himax hi2
      exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
    · obtain ⟨b1, hb1, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
      cases b1
      · obtain ⟨i2, hi2, hres⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
        simp only [ok.injEq] at hres
        subst hres
        have := add_one_val i i2 himax hi2
        exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
      · obtain ⟨b2, hb2, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
        cases b2
        · obtain ⟨i2, hi2, hres⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
          simp only [ok.injEq] at hres
          subst hres
          have := add_one_val i i2 himax hi2
          exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
        · obtain ⟨b3, hb3, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
          cases b3
          · obtain ⟨i2, hi2, hres⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
            simp only [ok.injEq] at hres
            subst hres
            have := add_one_val i i2 himax hi2
            exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
          · simp at hrest
            subst res
            exact ⟨g, hg_in, hb, hb3⟩
  · simp at h; subst h; simp

theorem direct_loop_ok (db : model.Db) (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64)
    (p : model.Permission) (r_res : model.Resource) (now : I64)
    (i : Usize) (hi : i.val ≤ db.grants.val.length)
    (h : acl.direct_grant_exists_loop db types ids p r_res now i = ok true) :
    ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, acl.subject_matches g types ids = ok true ∧ acl.live g now = ok true := by
  have := loop_ok (fun i1 => acl.direct_grant_exists_loop.body db types ids p r_res now i1)
    (fun i => i.val ≤ db.grants.val.length)
    (fun b => b = true → ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, acl.subject_matches g types ids = ok true ∧ acl.live g now = ok true)
    (fun i => db.grants.val.length - i.val)
    (by
      intro x r hinv hr
      have hs := direct_step db types ids p r_res now x r hinv hr
      cases r with
      | done y =>
        cases y
        · intro hy; contradiction
        · intro _; exact hs
      | cont x' => exact hs)
    i true hi h
  exact this rfl

theorem direct_grant_exists_ok (db : model.Db) (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64)
    (p : model.Permission) (r_res : model.Resource) (now : I64)
    (h : acl.direct_grant_exists db types ids p r_res now = ok true) :
    ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, acl.subject_matches g types ids = ok true ∧ acl.live g now = ok true := by
  unfold acl.direct_grant_exists at h
  exact direct_loop_ok db types ids p r_res now 0#usize (by simp) h

theorem direct_grant_exists_token (db : model.Db) (t : U64) (r : model.Resource)
    (p : model.Permission) (now : I64)
    (types : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (ids : alloc.vec.Vec U64)
    (hmatch : acl.subject_match_set db (.Token t) = ok (types, ids))
    (h : acl.direct_grant_exists db types.deref ids.deref p r now = ok true) :
    ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.subject = .Token t ∧ Live g now := by
  have hex := direct_grant_exists_ok db types.deref ids.deref p r now h
  exact token_grant_of_match db t now types ids hmatch hex

/-! ## Loop 2: folder_cascade_grant_exists -/

theorem folder_cascade_step (db : model.Db) (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64)
    (p : model.Permission) (now : I64) (target : alloc.vec.Vec U64)
    (i : Usize) (res : ControlFlow Usize Bool)
    (_ : i.val ≤ db.grants.val.length)
    (h : acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists_loop.body db types ids p now target i = ok res) :
    match res with
    | .done true => ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, acl.subject_matches g types ids = ok true ∧ acl.live g now = ok true
    | .done false => True
    | .cont i' => i'.val ≤ db.grants.val.length ∧ db.grants.val.length - i'.val < db.grants.val.length - i.val := by
  unfold acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists_loop.body at h
  dsimp only at h
  split at h
  · rename_i hlt
    have hlt_nat : i.val < db.grants.val.length := by
      have : (alloc.vec.Vec.len db.grants).val = db.grants.val.length := alloc.vec.Vec.len_val db.grants
      scalar_tac
    have himax : i.val < Usize.max := by
      have hp := db.grants.property
      omega
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
    have hg_in : g ∈ db.grants.val := by
      rw [alloc.vec.Vec.index_slice_index, alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize] at hg
      split at hg
      · simp at hg
      · rename_i hsome
        simp only [ok.injEq] at hg
        subst hg
        exact List.mem_of_getElem? hsome
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
    cases b
    · obtain ⟨i2, hi2, hres⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
      simp only [ok.injEq] at hres
      subst hres
      have := add_one_val i i2 himax hi2
      exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
    · obtain ⟨b1, hb1, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
      cases b1
      · obtain ⟨i2, hi2, hres⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
        simp only [ok.injEq] at hres
        subst hres
        have := add_one_val i i2 himax hi2
        exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
      · obtain ⟨b2, hb2, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
        cases b2
        · obtain ⟨i2, hi2, hres⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
          simp only [ok.injEq] at hres
          subst hres
          have := add_one_val i i2 himax hi2
          exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
        · obtain ⟨b3, hb3, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
          cases b3
          · obtain ⟨i2, hi2, hres⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
            simp only [ok.injEq] at hres
            subst hres
            have := add_one_val i i2 himax hi2
            exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
          · simp at hrest
            subst res
            exact ⟨g, hg_in, hb, hb2⟩
  · simp at h; subst h; simp

theorem folder_cascade_loop_ok (db : model.Db) (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64)
    (p : model.Permission) (now : I64) (target : alloc.vec.Vec U64)
    (i : Usize) (hi : i.val ≤ db.grants.val.length)
    (h : acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists_loop db types ids p now target i = ok true) :
    ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, acl.subject_matches g types ids = ok true ∧ acl.live g now = ok true := by
  have := loop_ok (fun i1 => acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists_loop.body db types ids p now target i1)
    (fun i => i.val ≤ db.grants.val.length)
    (fun b => b = true → ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, acl.subject_matches g types ids = ok true ∧ acl.live g now = ok true)
    (fun i => db.grants.val.length - i.val)
    (by
      intro x r hinv hr
      have hs := folder_cascade_step db types ids p now target x r hinv hr
      cases r with
      | done y =>
        cases y
        · intro hy; contradiction
        · intro _; exact hs
      | cont x' => exact hs)
    i true hi h
  exact this rfl

theorem folder_cascade_grant_exists_ok (db : model.Db) (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64)
    (p : model.Permission) (folder_id : U64) (now : I64)
    (h : acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists db types ids p folder_id now = ok true) :
    ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, acl.subject_matches g types ids = ok true ∧ acl.live g now = ok true := by
  unfold acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists at h
  obtain ⟨o, ho, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
  cases o with
  | none => simp at hrest
  | some f => exact folder_cascade_loop_ok db types ids p now f.lpath 0#usize (by simp) hrest

theorem cascade_grant_token (db : model.Db) (t : U64) (r : model.Resource)
    (p : model.Permission) (now : I64)
    (h : acl.cascade_grant db (.Token t) r p now = ok true) :
    ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.subject = .Token t ∧ Live g now := by
  unfold acl.cascade_grant at h
  cases r with
  | Drive _ | Calendar _ | AddressBook _ | Playlist _ => simp at h
  | Folder id =>
    obtain ⟨⟨types, ids⟩, hmatch, hfolder⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
    have hex := folder_cascade_grant_exists_ok db types.deref ids.deref p id now hfolder
    exact token_grant_of_match db t now types ids hmatch hex
  | File id =>
    obtain ⟨o, ho, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
    obtain ⟨folder_allowed, hfa, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
    cases folder_allowed with
    | false =>
      simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hrest
      obtain ⟨⟨types, ids⟩, hmatch, hdirect⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
      have hex := direct_grant_exists_ok db types.deref ids.deref p (model.Resource.File id) now hdirect
      exact token_grant_of_match db t now types ids hmatch hex
    | true =>
      cases o with
      | none => simp at hfa
      | some parent =>
        obtain ⟨⟨types, ids⟩, hmatch, hfolder⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hfa
        have hex := folder_cascade_grant_exists_ok db types.deref ids.deref p parent now hfolder
        exact token_grant_of_match db t now types ids hmatch hex

/-! ## Loop 3: caller_role_on_drive -/

theorem stronger_cases (a : Option model.Role) (b : model.Role) (r : Option model.Role)
    (h : acl.stronger a b = ok r) :
    r = some b ∨ r = a := by
  unfold acl.stronger at h
  cases a with
  | none => simp at h; subst h; left; rfl
  | some x =>
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
    obtain ⟨i1, hi1, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
    split at hrest
    · simp at hrest; subst hrest; left; rfl
    · simp at hrest; subst hrest; right; rfl

theorem caller_role_step (db : model.Db) (drive_id : U64) (now : I64)
    (types : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (ids : alloc.vec.Vec U64)
    (best : Option model.Role) (i : Usize)
    (res : ControlFlow ((Option model.Role) × Usize) (Option model.Role))
    (hinv : i.val ≤ db.grants.val.length ∧ (best ≠ none → ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, acl.subject_matches g (alloc.vec.Vec.deref types) (alloc.vec.Vec.deref ids) = ok true ∧ acl.live g now = ok true))
    (h : acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop.body db drive_id now types ids best i = ok res) :
    match res with
    | .done r => r ≠ none → ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, acl.subject_matches g (alloc.vec.Vec.deref types) (alloc.vec.Vec.deref ids) = ok true ∧ acl.live g now = ok true
    | .cont (best', i') => (i'.val ≤ db.grants.val.length ∧ (best' ≠ none → ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, acl.subject_matches g (alloc.vec.Vec.deref types) (alloc.vec.Vec.deref ids) = ok true ∧ acl.live g now = ok true)) ∧
        db.grants.val.length - i'.val < db.grants.val.length - i.val := by
  unfold acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop.body at h
  dsimp only at h
  split at h
  · rename_i hlt
    have hlt_nat : i.val < db.grants.val.length := by
      have : (alloc.vec.Vec.len db.grants).val = db.grants.val.length := alloc.vec.Vec.len_val db.grants
      scalar_tac
    have himax : i.val < Usize.max := by
      have hp := db.grants.property
      omega
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
    have hg_in : g ∈ db.grants.val := by
      rw [alloc.vec.Vec.index_slice_index, alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize] at hg
      split at hg
      · simp at hg
      · rename_i hsome
        simp only [ok.injEq] at hg
        subst hg
        exact List.mem_of_getElem? hsome
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
    obtain ⟨best1, hbest1, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
    obtain ⟨i2, hi2, hres⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
    simp only [ok.injEq] at hres
    subst hres
    have hi2_val := add_one_val i i2 himax hi2
    have hbest_cases : best1 ≠ none → ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, acl.subject_matches g (alloc.vec.Vec.deref types) (alloc.vec.Vec.deref ids) = ok true ∧ acl.live g now = ok true := by
      cases b
      · simp at hbest1; subst hbest1; exact hinv.2
      · obtain ⟨b1, hb1, hbest1⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hbest1
        cases b1
        · simp at hbest1; subst hbest1; exact hinv.2
        · obtain ⟨b2, hb2, hbest1⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hbest1
          cases b2
          · simp at hbest1; subst hbest1; exact hinv.2
          · rcases stronger_cases best g.role best1 hbest1 with rfl | rfl
            · intro _; exact ⟨g, hg_in, hb, hb2⟩
            · exact hinv.2
    refine ⟨⟨by omega, hbest_cases⟩, by omega⟩
  · simp only [ok.injEq] at h; subst h; exact hinv.2

theorem caller_role_loop_ok (db : model.Db) (drive_id : U64) (now : I64)
    (types : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (ids : alloc.vec.Vec U64)
    (best : Option model.Role) (i : Usize) (role : model.Role)
    (hi : i.val ≤ db.grants.val.length)
    (hbest : best ≠ none → ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, acl.subject_matches g (alloc.vec.Vec.deref types) (alloc.vec.Vec.deref ids) = ok true ∧ acl.live g now = ok true)
    (h : acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop db drive_id now types ids best i = ok (some role)) :
    ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, acl.subject_matches g (alloc.vec.Vec.deref types) (alloc.vec.Vec.deref ids) = ok true ∧ acl.live g now = ok true := by
  unfold acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop at h
  have := loop_ok (fun p => acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop.body db drive_id now types ids p.1 p.2)
    (fun p => p.2.val ≤ db.grants.val.length ∧ (p.1 ≠ none → ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, acl.subject_matches g (alloc.vec.Vec.deref types) (alloc.vec.Vec.deref ids) = ok true ∧ acl.live g now = ok true))
    (fun r => r ≠ none → ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, acl.subject_matches g (alloc.vec.Vec.deref types) (alloc.vec.Vec.deref ids) = ok true ∧ acl.live g now = ok true)
    (fun p => db.grants.val.length - p.2.val)
    (by
      intro p r hinv hr
      have hs := caller_role_step db drive_id now types ids p.1 p.2 r hinv hr
      cases r with
      | done y => exact hs
      | cont p' => exact hs)
    (best, i) (some role) ⟨hi, hbest⟩ h
  exact this (by simp)

theorem caller_role_on_drive_some (db : model.Db) (s : model.Subject) (drive_id : U64) (now : I64)
    (role : model.Role) (h : acl.caller_role_on_drive db s drive_id now = ok (some role)) :
    ∃ (types : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (ids : alloc.vec.Vec U64),
      acl.subject_match_set db s = ok (types, ids) ∧
      ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, acl.subject_matches g (alloc.vec.Vec.deref types) (alloc.vec.Vec.deref ids) = ok true ∧ acl.live g now = ok true := by
  unfold acl.caller_role_on_drive at h
  obtain ⟨⟨types, ids⟩, hmatch, hloop⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
  refine ⟨types, ids, hmatch, ?_⟩
  exact caller_role_loop_ok db drive_id now types ids none 0#usize role (by simp) (by simp) hloop

theorem caller_role_on_drive_token (db : model.Db) (drive_id : U64) (now : I64) (t : U64)
    (role : model.Role) (h : acl.caller_role_on_drive db (.Token t) drive_id now = ok (some role)) :
    ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.subject = .Token t ∧ Live g now := by
  obtain ⟨types, ids, hmatch, hex⟩ := caller_role_on_drive_some db (.Token t) drive_id now role h
  exact token_grant_of_match db t now types ids hmatch hex

theorem role_has_some (r : Option model.Role) (p : model.Permission)
    (h : acl.role_has r p = ok true) :
    ∃ role, r = some role := by
  unfold acl.role_has at h
  cases r with
  | none => simp at h
  | some role => exact ⟨role, rfl⟩

/-! ## Main theorem -/

theorem token_needs_its_own_grant (db : model.Db) (ro : Bool) (now : I64) (t : U64)
    (p : model.Permission) (r : model.Resource) (h : acl.check db ro now (.Token t) p r = ok true) :
    ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.subject = .Token t ∧ Live g now := by
  unfold acl.check at h
  dsimp only at h
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
  cases r with
  | Calendar id | AddressBook id | Playlist id =>
    split at hrest
    · case isTrue b_true =>
      split at hrest
      · simp at hrest
      · obtain ⟨is_storage, his, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
        simp only [ok.injEq] at his; subst is_storage
        simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hrest
        obtain ⟨⟨types, ids⟩, hmatch, hdirect⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
        exact direct_grant_exists_token db t _ p now types ids hmatch hdirect
    · case isFalse b_false =>
      obtain ⟨is_storage, his, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
      simp only [ok.injEq] at his; subst is_storage
      simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hrest
      obtain ⟨⟨types, ids⟩, hmatch, hdirect⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
      exact direct_grant_exists_token db t _ p now types ids hmatch hdirect
  | Drive id =>
    split at hrest
    · case isTrue b_true =>
      split at hrest
      · simp at hrest
      · obtain ⟨is_storage, his, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
        simp only [ok.injEq] at his; subst is_storage
        simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hrest
        obtain ⟨dp1, hdp1, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
        split at hrest
        · simp at hrest
        · obtain ⟨o2, ho2, hrole⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
          obtain ⟨role, rfl⟩ := role_has_some o2 p hrole
          exact caller_role_on_drive_token db id now t role ho2
    · case isFalse b_false =>
      obtain ⟨is_storage, his, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
      simp only [ok.injEq] at his; subst is_storage
      simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hrest
      obtain ⟨o2, ho2, hrole⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
      obtain ⟨role, rfl⟩ := role_has_some o2 p hrole
      exact caller_role_on_drive_token db id now t role ho2
  | Folder id | File id =>
    split at hrest
    · case isTrue b_true =>
      split at hrest
      · simp at hrest
      · obtain ⟨is_storage, his, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
        simp only [ok.injEq] at his; subst is_storage
        obtain ⟨o, ho, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
        cases o with
        | none => simp at hrest
        | some d =>
          obtain ⟨dp, hdp, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
          split at hrest
          · simp at hrest
          · obtain ⟨o1, ho1, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
            obtain ⟨b1, hb1, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
            split at hrest
            · rename_i hb1_true; subst b1
              obtain ⟨role, rfl⟩ := role_has_some o1 p hb1
              exact caller_role_on_drive_token db d now t role ho1
            · exact cascade_grant_token db t _ p now hrest
    · case isFalse b_false =>
      obtain ⟨is_storage, his, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
      simp only [ok.injEq] at his; subst is_storage
      obtain ⟨o, ho, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
      cases o with
      | none => simp at hrest
      | some d =>
        obtain ⟨o1, ho1, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
        obtain ⟨b1, hb1, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
        split at hrest
        · rename_i hb1_true; subst b1
          obtain ⟨role, rfl⟩ := role_has_some o1 p hb1
          exact caller_role_on_drive_token db d now t role ho1
        · exact cascade_grant_token db t _ p now hrest

end oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudTokenGrant

  all_goals subst s
  all_goals have hc := copy_ok _ _ h
  all_goals simpa [RoleWire, Array.to_slice, Array.make] using hc

theorem stored_ok (raw : Slice U8) (o : Option userrole.UserRole)
    (h : userrole.from_stored raw = ok o) (r : userrole.UserRole) :
    (o = some r ↔ StoredRole raw.val r) := by
  unfold userrole.from_stored at h
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals simp only [lift, Result.ok.injEq] at *
  all_goals subst_vars
  all_goals have he := equal_ok _ _ _ hb
  all_goals try have he1 := equal_ok _ _ _ hb1
  all_goals try have he2 := equal_ok _ _ _ hb2
  all_goals cases r <;> simp_all [StoredRole, RoleWire, Array.to_slice, Array.make]

/-- Session parsing adds only the canonical anonymous spelling. -/
theorem session_ok (raw : Slice U8) (o : Option userrole.UserRole)
    (h : userrole.from_session raw = ok o) (r : userrole.UserRole) :
    (o = some r ↔ SessionRole raw.val r) := by
  unfold userrole.from_session at h
  h5i_invert h
  · simp only [lift, Result.ok.injEq] at hs
    subst s
    have he := equal_ok _ _ _ hb
    cases r <;> simp_all [SessionRole, RoleWire, Array.to_slice, Array.make]
  · simp only [lift, Result.ok.injEq] at hs
    subst s
    have he := equal_ok _ _ _ hb
    have ho := stored_ok raw o h r
    cases r <;> simp_all [SessionRole, StoredRole, RoleWire, Array.to_slice, Array.make]

/-- Unrecognized roles cannot satisfy even the anonymous requirement. -/
theorem str_at_least_ok (raw : Slice U8) (min : userrole.UserRole) (b : Bool)
    (h : userrole.str_at_least raw min = ok b) : (b = true ↔ MeetsRole raw.val min) := by
  unfold userrole.str_at_least at h
  h5i_invert h
  · have hs := session_ok raw none ho
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff]
    rintro ⟨r, hr, _⟩
    have := (hs r).2 hr
    simp at this
  · have hs := session_ok raw (some role) ho
    have hb := at_least_ok role min b h
    rw [hb]
    constructor
    · intro hr
      exact ⟨role, (hs role).1 rfl, hr⟩
    · rintro ⟨r, hr, hl⟩
      have he : role = r := Option.some.inj ((hs r).2 hr)
      simpa [he] using hl

theorem email_ok (claim : Option Bool) (required : Bool) (d : validation.EmailDecision)
    (h : validation.classify_email_verification claim required = ok d) :
    VerifiedEmailDecision claim required d := by
  cases claim with
  | none =>
    cases required <;> simp_all [validation.classify_email_verification] <;>
      subst d <;> simp [VerifiedEmailDecision]
  | some claim =>
    cases claim <;> cases required <;>
      simp_all [validation.classify_email_verification] <;> subst d <;> simp [VerifiedEmailDecision]

theorem storage_byte_ok (b : U8) (r : Bool) (h : validation.storage_byte b = ok r) :
    (r = true ↔ StorageByte b) := by
  unfold validation.storage_byte at h
  h5i_invert h <;> simp_all [StorageByte] <;> scalar_tac

theorem base64url_byte_ok (b : U8) (r : Bool) (h : validation.base64url_byte b = ok r) :
    (r = true ↔ Base64UrlByte b) := by
  unfold validation.base64url_byte at h
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals have hp := storage_byte_ok _ _ hb1
  all_goals simp_all [Base64UrlByte] <;> scalar_tac




theorem all_storage_ok (raw : Slice U8) (r : Bool)
    (h : validation.all_storage raw = ok r) :
    (r = true ↔ ∀ b ∈ raw.val, StorageByte b) := by
  unfold validation.all_storage validation.all_storage_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _
    (fun i : Usize => ∀ j < i.val, ∀ b, raw.val[j]? = some b → StorageByte b)
    (fun r => r = true ↔ ∀ b ∈ raw.val, StorageByte b)
    (fun i => raw.val.length - i.val) ?_ 0#usize r (by simp) h
  intro i result hp hr
  unfold validation.all_storage_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · obtain ⟨hi, he⟩ := slice_index_ok hi2
    have hb' := storage_byte_ok _ _ hb
    have hj := add_ok_val hi3
    refine ⟨?_, by scalar_tac⟩
    intro j hji b heq
    by_cases hji' : j < i.val
    · exact hp j hji' b heq
    · have hj' : j = i.val := by scalar_tac
      subst j
      have heq' : raw.val[i.val]? = some i2 := by simp [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi, he]
      have : b = i2 := by simp_all
      subst b
      exact hb'.1 hc_1
  · obtain ⟨hi, he⟩ := slice_index_ok hi2
    have hb' := storage_byte_ok _ _ hb
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff]
    intro hall
    have hm : i2 ∈ raw.val := by rw [← he]; exact List.getElem_mem hi
    have : StorageByte i2 := hall i2 hm
    simp_all
  · simp only [true_iff]
    intro b hb
    obtain ⟨j, hj, he⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.1 hb
    apply hp j (by scalar_tac) b
    simp [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hj, he]

theorem all_base64url_ok (raw : Slice U8) (r : Bool)
    (h : validation.all_base64url raw = ok r) :
    (r = true ↔ ∀ b ∈ raw.val, Base64UrlByte b) := by
  unfold validation.all_base64url validation.all_base64url_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _
    (fun i : Usize => ∀ j < i.val, ∀ b, raw.val[j]? = some b → Base64UrlByte b)
    (fun r => r = true ↔ ∀ b ∈ raw.val, Base64UrlByte b)
    (fun i => raw.val.length - i.val) ?_ 0#usize r (by simp) h
  intro i result hp hr
  unfold validation.all_base64url_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · obtain ⟨hi, he⟩ := slice_index_ok hi2
    have hb' := base64url_byte_ok _ _ hb
    have hj := add_ok_val hi3
    refine ⟨?_, by scalar_tac⟩
    intro j hji b heq
    by_cases hji' : j < i.val
    · exact hp j hji' b heq
    · have hj' : j = i.val := by scalar_tac
      subst j
      have heq' : raw.val[i.val]? = some i2 := by simp [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi, he]
      have : b = i2 := by simp_all
      subst b
      exact hb'.1 hc_1
  · obtain ⟨hi, he⟩ := slice_index_ok hi2
    have hb' := base64url_byte_ok _ _ hb
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff]
    intro hall
    have hm : i2 ∈ raw.val := by rw [← he]; exact List.getElem_mem hi
    have : Base64UrlByte i2 := hall i2 hm
    simp_all
  · simp only [true_iff]
    intro b hb
    obtain ⟨j, hj, he⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.1 hb
    apply hp j (by scalar_tac) b
    simp [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hj, he]

/-- Accepted storage selectors have a bounded length and exclude every character outside
lowercase ASCII letters, decimal digits, hyphens, and underscores. -/
theorem storage_name_ok (raw : Slice U8) (r : Bool)
    (h : validation.is_valid_entry_name raw = ok r) : (r = true ↔ ValidStorageName raw.val) := by
  unfold validation.is_valid_entry_name at h
  h5i_invert h
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff]
    simp only [ValidStorageName]
    intro hall
    scalar_tac
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff]
    simp only [ValidStorageName]
    intro hall
    scalar_tac
  · have ha := all_storage_ok _ _ h
    simp only [ValidStorageName]
    have hlo : 1 ≤ raw.val.length := by scalar_tac
    have hhi : raw.val.length ≤ 32 := by scalar_tac
    simpa [hlo, hhi] using ha

/-- Thumbprint validation preserves the accepted input exactly and classifies invalid shapes. -/
theorem jkt_ok (raw : Slice U8)
    (r : core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8) validation.JktError)
    (h : validation.validate_dpop_jkt raw = ok r) : JktDecision raw.val r := by
  unfold validation.validate_dpop_jkt at h
  h5i_invert h
  · simp only [JktDecision]
    scalar_tac
  · have ha := all_base64url_ok _ _ hb
    have hc' := copy_ok _ _ hv
    simp only [JktDecision, ValidJkt]
    exact ⟨⟨by scalar_tac, ha.1 hc_1⟩, hc'⟩
  · have ha := all_base64url_ok _ _ hb
    simp only [JktDecision]
    exact ⟨by scalar_tac, by simp_all⟩

end oxicloud_kernel.Verified.OxicloudValidation

import Verified.Derived
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result oxicloud_kernel
open H5iAppLib hiding lit
namespace oxicloud_kernel.PolicySpec
/-- A drive's explicit choices override its kind's defaults, including explicit
false choices. An absent expiry cap override inherits the default cap. -/
def PolicyResolved (d : drivepolicy.Policies) (o : drivepolicy.Overrides)
    (r : drivepolicy.Policies) : Prop :=
  r.forbid_sharing = o.forbid_sharing.getD d.forbid_sharing ∧
  r.forbid_external_sharing = o.forbid_external_sharing.getD d.forbid_external_sharing ∧
  r.forbid_public_links = o.forbid_public_links.getD d.forbid_public_links ∧
  r.forbid_cross_drive_move = o.forbid_cross_drive_move.getD d.forbid_cross_drive_move ∧
  r.forbid_owner_role_change = o.forbid_owner_role_change.getD d.forbid_owner_role_change ∧
  r.include_in_photo_index = o.include_in_photo_index.getD d.include_in_photo_index ∧
  r.include_in_music_index = o.include_in_music_index.getD d.include_in_music_index ∧
  r.read_only = o.read_only.getD d.read_only ∧
  r.require_public_link_password = o.require_public_link_password.getD d.require_public_link_password ∧
  r.max_public_link_days = o.max_public_link_days.or d.max_public_link_days

/-- Both the broad sharing policy and the link-specific policy permit minting. -/
def PublicLinksAllowed (p : drivepolicy.Policies) : Prop :=
  p.forbid_sharing = false ∧ p.forbid_public_links = false

def SharingAllowed (p : drivepolicy.Policies) : Prop := p.forbid_sharing = false

/-- Administrators may manage a locked owner roster. -/
def OwnerChangesAllowed (p : drivepolicy.Policies) (admin : Bool) : Prop :=
  p.forbid_owner_role_change = false ∨ admin = true

def CrossDriveMoveAllowed (p : drivepolicy.Policies) : Prop :=
  p.forbid_cross_drive_move = false

/-- Only external user principals are constrained by the external-sharing knob. -/
def ExternalSharingAllowed (p : drivepolicy.Policies) (s : model.Subject) (external : Bool) : Prop :=
  p.forbid_external_sharing = false ∨ (∀ id, s ≠ .User id) ∨ external = false

/-- A policy guard succeeds exactly when allowed and otherwise returns the
canonical unsupported-operation refusal. -/
def GuardDecision (allowed : Prop) (r : core.result.Result Unit model.ErrorKind) : Prop :=
  (r = .Ok () ↔ allowed) ∧ (r = .Err .OperationNotSupported ↔ ¬allowed)




/-- Canonical order of independently configurable drive policies. -/
def PolicyKnobOrder : List policycompare.Knob :=
  [.ForbidSharing, .ForbidExternalSharing, .ForbidPublicLinks, .ForbidCrossDriveMove,
   .ForbidOwnerRoleChange, .IncludeInPhotoIndex, .IncludeInMusicIndex, .ReadOnly,
   .MaxPublicLinkDays, .RequirePublicLinkPassword]

def PolicyBit (p : drivepolicy.Policies) : policycompare.Knob → Bool
  | .ForbidSharing => p.forbid_sharing
  | .ForbidExternalSharing => p.forbid_external_sharing
  | .ForbidPublicLinks => p.forbid_public_links
  | .ForbidCrossDriveMove => p.forbid_cross_drive_move
  | .ForbidOwnerRoleChange => p.forbid_owner_role_change
  | .IncludeInPhotoIndex => p.include_in_photo_index
  | .IncludeInMusicIndex => p.include_in_music_index
  | .ReadOnly => p.read_only
  | .RequirePublicLinkPassword => p.require_public_link_password
  | _ => false

/-- Every configured upper bound is respected, with no bound weaker than any finite bound. -/
def PolicyCapRefines (own required : Option U32) : Prop :=
  ∀ bound, required = some bound → ∃ cap, own = some cap ∧ cap.val ≤ bound.val

/-- Refinement preserves prohibitions, reduces index exposure, and tightens link lifetimes. -/
def PolicyRefines (p q : drivepolicy.Policies) (knob : policycompare.Knob) : Prop :=
  match knob with
  | .MaxPublicLinkDays => PolicyCapRefines p.max_public_link_days q.max_public_link_days
  | .IncludeInPhotoIndex | .IncludeInMusicIndex => PolicyBit p knob = true → PolicyBit q knob = true
  | _ => PolicyBit q knob = true → PolicyBit p knob = true

def PolicyApplies (knob : policycompare.Knob) (kind : model.DriveKind) : Prop :=
  knob ≠ .ForbidOwnerRoleChange ∨ kind ≠ .Personal

def PolicyDefaultable (knob : policycompare.Knob) : Prop := knob ≠ .ReadOnly

/-- Drift consists only of applicable standing defaults that the current drive fails to refine. -/
def PolicyWeak (p d : drivepolicy.Policies) (kind : model.DriveKind) (knob : policycompare.Knob) : Prop :=
  PolicyApplies knob kind ∧ PolicyDefaultable knob ∧ ¬PolicyRefines p d knob

noncomputable def PolicyWeakerList (p d : drivepolicy.Policies) (kind : model.DriveKind) : List policycompare.Knob := by
  classical
  exact PolicyKnobOrder.filter (fun knob => decide (PolicyWeak p d kind knob))

/-- Policy values have exactly the boolean, bounded-integer, or null shape declared by their knob. -/
def PolicyValue (p : drivepolicy.Policies) (knob : policycompare.Knob) (out : policycompare.KnobValue) : Prop :=
  match knob with
  | .Other => out = .Null
  | .MaxPublicLinkDays =>
    match p.max_public_link_days with
    | none => out = .Null
    | some n => out = .Number n
  | _ => out = .Bool (PolicyBit p knob)

/-- Opt-in indices are false-stricter, link lifetime is smaller-stricter, and other flags are true-stricter. -/
def PolicyStrictness (knob : policycompare.Knob) (out : policycompare.Strictness) : Prop :=
  match knob with
  | .IncludeInPhotoIndex | .IncludeInMusicIndex => out = .FalseIsStricter
  | .MaxPublicLinkDays => out = .SmallerIsStricter
  | _ => out = .TrueIsStricter



end oxicloud_kernel.PolicySpec

    | (rw [drive_of_eq db _ (by rfl), hd_original]; simp [hdp, hro])

theorem drive_of_eq (db : model.Db) (r : model.Resource)
    (hs : isStorage r = true) : acl.drive_of db r = ok (driveOf db r) := by
  apply eq_ok_of_spec
  cases r <;> simp [isStorage] at hs
  all_goals
    unfold acl.drive_of driveOf
    step* <;> simp_all
  all_goals exact ⟨_, o_post.symm, rfl⟩

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

theorem policies_for_storage (db : model.Db) (r : model.Resource) (d : U64)
    (dr : model.Drive) (hs : isStorage r = true) (hd : driveOf db r = some d)
    (hr : driveRow db d = some dr) :
    grantapi.policies_for db r = ok (.Ok dr.policies) := by
  have hdo := drive_of_eq db r hs
  have hdp : acl.drive_policies db d = ok dr.policies := by
    simpa [hr] using eq_ok_of_spec (drive_policies_spec db d)
  cases r <;> simp [isStorage] at hs
  all_goals unfold grantapi.policies_for
  all_goals simp [hdo, hd, hdp]

theorem create_respects_sharing_policies (db db' : model.Db) (env : grantapi.Env) (caller : U64)
    (r : model.Resource) (s : model.Subject) (role : model.Role) (e : Option I64) (rep : grantapi.Reply)
    (d : U64) (dr : model.Drive) (hst : isStorage r = true) (hd : driveOf db r = some d)
    (hr : driveRow db d = some dr)
    (h : grantapi.transition db env caller (.CreateGrant r s role e) = ok (db', .Ok rep)) :
    dr.policies.forbid_sharing = false ∧ (∀ t, s = .Token t → dr.policies.forbid_public_links = false) := by
  unfold grantapi.transition grantapi.create_grant at h
  obtain ⟨decision, hdecision, h⟩ := bind_eq_ok.1 h
  cases decision with
  | Err err =>
    h5i_invert h
    all_goals simp_all
  | Ok unit =>
    obtain ⟨gate, hgate, h⟩ := bind_eq_ok.1 h
    cases gate with
    | Err err =>
      h5i_invert h
      all_goals simp_all
    | Ok unit =>
      unfold grantapi.create_gates at hgate
      rw [policies_for_storage db r d dr hst hd hr] at hgate
      cases r <;> simp [isStorage] at hst
      all_goals
        simp [grantapi.is_drive, core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch] at hgate
        h5i_invert hgate
        all_goals simp_all
      all_goals
        intro t hs
        subst s
        simp at htoken
